updates.new_facts: Samuel utilizes a combat identity focused on close-quarters combat, structural warfare, and adaptive martial arts including Lethwei, Krav Maga, Combat Sambo, and Silat. He possesses extreme pain tolerance, mental endurance, Ghost Sense for extreme situational awareness, and Threat Threading. His signature weapon is a softcore armament disguised as a tie that can harden beyond known metal and act as a razor-sharp, unbreakable tool.
updates.quote: Samuel’s overall fighting style? Close-Quarters Structural Warfare. Short description: A momentum-based, anatomy-targeting combat system that blends brutal clinch striking with redirection throws and joint destruction
